title: A Snowy Day
description: Tom and Lucy have fun in the snow.
instructions: Read about Tom and Lucy. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: ⛄ When Tom woke up on Tuesday, he looked out of the window. Everything was white! It snowed all night.
There was no school because the roads were icy. Tom was very happy. He put on his warm coat, hat, scarf and gloves.
In the garden, Tom and his sister Lucy made a big snowman. They used two stones for his eyes and a carrot for his nose. Lucy gave him her blue scarf.
Then they went to the hill near their house. They went down the hill on a red sledge. It was fast and they shouted, 'Wheee!'
After an hour, their hands were cold and their noses were red. They went home and Mum made hot soup. 'Take off your wet shoes first,' she said.
In the afternoon, the sun came out. The snow started to melt. By evening, the snowman was small, but Tom and Lucy were not sad. 'We can make a new one tomorrow,' said Lucy.
